twilio.title: Connect Twilio step by step
twilio.hint: You need the account SID and the auth token from the Twilio console, and you should know what messages can and cannot do inside Saudi Arabia before you start.

credentials.title: Copy the account SID and the auth token
credentials.body: On the Twilio console home page copy the Account SID, which starts with AC, and the Auth Token. Paste the first into the account ID field and the second into the auth token field below.

apiKeys.title: API keys are not accepted
apiKeys.body: Do not use an API key (it starts with SK). LiwanOS needs the auth token itself, because Twilio signs its delivery notifications with it.

trial.title: Trial account limits
trial.body: A trial account can only send to numbers you verified in Twilio, and every message starts with a trial notice. Upgrade to a paid account before real use.

region.title: Data is processed outside Saudi Arabia
region.body: Twilio has no region in the Middle East. Recipient numbers and message text pass through Twilio servers outside the Kingdom, so make sure this fits your company policy.

saudiSender.title: The Saudi sender rule
saudiSender.body: Messages to Saudi numbers need a sender name pre-registered with Twilio, and Twilio does not currently issue one to domestic Saudi brands. Check that sending to Saudi Arabia works for you before you rely on it.

charges.title: Charges go to your own Twilio account
charges.body: Every message is billed from your company's own Twilio balance and LiwanOS charges nothing for it. The daily limit on the communications page protects you from a wrong send loop.

result.credentialsDone: Twilio accepted the SID and the auth token.
result.credentialsTodo: No auth token is saved yet.
result.credentialsProblem: Twilio refused the SID or the token, or the account is suspended or closed.

meta.title: Connect WhatsApp step by step
meta.hint: Five steps at Meta. The first time takes about twenty minutes.

app.title: Create the Meta app
app.body: In Meta for Developers create an app of the Business type, then add the WhatsApp product to it.

token.title: Create a system user token
token.body: In Meta Business Settings add a system user, give it your WhatsApp account, and generate a token with the permissions. Paste it as the access token below.

values.title: Find each value in the Meta dashboard
values.body: Copy each value into the field with the same name in this form.
values.accountId: WhatsApp Business Account ID: WhatsApp > API Setup. Enter it as the account ID.
values.appId: Find the App ID and the app secret under App settings > Basic.
values.phoneId: Phone number ID: WhatsApp > API Setup. You enter it later when you add the number in the customer messages settings.

webhook.title: Paste the webhook address and verify token
webhook.body: In WhatsApp > Configuration, set the callback URL to the receiving address and the verify token to the one LiwanOS shows you.
webhook.before: After you save the account, LiwanOS shows the address and creates the verify token. Rotate it to see its value once.
webhook.after: The address is under Receiving addresses below. Rotate the verify token to see its value once.

fields.title: Subscribe to the webhook fields
fields.body: Subscribe to the fields LiwanOS processes. The first is required; the others keep templates, forms and number health up to date.

result.tokenTodo: No access token is saved yet.
result.tokenProblem: Meta did not accept the token.
result.valuesDone: The account ID was verified and the app secret is saved.
result.valuesTodo: The app secret is not saved yet.
result.valuesProblem: The account ID or the token was refused.
result.webhookDone: The verify token is ready. Whether Meta confirmed the address cannot be seen from here.
result.webhookTodo: The verify token is not created yet.

limit.title: Daily limits and recording
limit.hint: The most messages and calls your company makes in a day. They stop a repeated-send mistake from using up your Twilio balance.
limit.label: Messages per day
limit.recordCallsHint: Calls are placed with recording after you switch this on. Only the recording reference is stored in LiwanOS, never the audio, and recording needs your company's own legal basis.
limit.invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
limit.callInvalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

test.title: Test send
test.hint: Send one message to check that the account and the sender work, and follow its state.
test.noSenderHint: Add an active SMS or WhatsApp sender first.
test.toHint: Your own number for the test, in international format like +9665XXXXXXXX.
test.toInvalid: Write the number in international format, like +9665XXXXXXXX.
test.textHint: A test message with a fixed Arabic text set by the system is sent.
test.templateHint: A template approved in Twilio, starting with HX. WhatsApp outside the conversation window accepts approved templates only.
test.templateInvalid: The template ID starts with HX followed by 32 characters.
test.variablesHint: One value per line as 1=value. Leave empty if the template has no variables.
test.variablesInvalid: Write each value on its own line as 1=value.

voice.title: Test call
voice.hint: Place one call to check that the account and the voice number work, and follow its state. A call is never placed again automatically.
voice.noSender: No voice number to call from
voice.noSenderHint: Add an active voice sender first.
voice.textHint: What the call says to the recipient, up to {max} characters. Empty speaks a fixed Arabic sentence set by the system.
voice.textTooLong: The text is longer than {max} characters.
voice.agentNumberHint: Your own number for the test. The call reaches it first, then dials the recipient in.
voice.bridgeHint: A bridge call carries no spoken text: the agent and the recipient speak to each other.

hint.initiated: LiwanOS handed the call to Twilio. Waiting for it to ring.
hint.in_progress: Someone answered and the call is live.
hint.completed: The call ended and was answered.
hint.failed: The call could not be placed or was cut short.
hint.canceled: The call was canceled before it was answered.
hint.unconfirmed: The connection broke while placing the call, so we do not know whether Twilio received the request. The call is never placed again automatically.

call.unconfirmedWarning: Do not place the call again right away: it may already be going out. Check the call's state at Twilio first.

calls.title: Call log
calls.hint: Every call your company placed and the state it reached, with its length and the recording reference when recording is on. Only the reference is stored, never the audio. Kept for 24 months.
calls.recordingPending: The recording reference has not arrived yet.

lookup.title: Check a number
lookup.hint: See whether a number is valid and how the provider writes it, before you send to it or call it. Nothing about the number is stored.
lookup.lineTypeHint: The line type (mobile, landline and the like) is a paid add-on that Twilio bills per request on your company's balance.

hint.queued: It waits its turn to be sent, usually within a minute.
hint.sent: LiwanOS handed it to Twilio. Waiting for the delivery receipt.
hint.sentNoReceipt: LiwanOS handed it to Twilio, and no delivery receipt will arrive because the system's public receiving address is not ready or not secure.
hint.delivered: Twilio confirmed the message reached the recipient.
hint.undelivered: The message did not reach the recipient.
hint.failed: The message was not sent. You can send it again.
hint.unconfirmed: The connection broke while sending, so we do not know whether Twilio received the request. We never resend automatically, so you are not charged twice.

message.retryUnconfirmedWarning: The first message may have arrived. Sending again may reach the recipient twice and be charged twice on your Twilio account.

log.title: Message log
log.hint: Every message your company sent and the last state it reached. Kept for 24 months.
